system.description: Sometimes a debater's opponent can brush her arguments aside without admitting their purpose. Once the devotee of Conviction learns this skill, she becomes expert at pressing her point, often repeating it ad nauseam, until her opponent concedes the point or simply gives up. This magical flurry provides another attack as long as the attack previous was unsuccessful. Each attack uses the martial artist's full dice pool and increases the onslaught penalty as normal. The martial artist may continue to attack at her full dice pool until she hits her opponent. She can make no more attempts than she has dots of Conviction, however, and each repeated attempt must be identical to the original attack.
system.source: Scroll of the Monk: The Imperfect Lotus
